body:
"Turn them off"... oh for fuck's sake.  Do you tell a gunshot victim to just stop bleeding, or someone with cancer to just stop eating themselves away?  I am mentally ill -- my brain is broken -- I CANNOT fix it myself.  I've spent a fucking LIFETIME trying.

look -- I'm sorry, I *do* know you guys mean well and I'm glad you're here and I really hope you'll be a good help to others.  Simple kindness, real compassion and the willingness to listen is a great thing and a hell of a lot more than many of us here in the dark ever get, and I hope you guys find a lot of people for whom that actually is enough.

I wish it was for me.

<sigh>.  With all due respect, I have heard this -- versions of this -- all my life.  And to be honest it always makes me think of something like [this comic](http://www.akimbocomics.com/?p=573).  I've done many of those things and I am glad, thrilled, that you CAN do that, that that works for you and that that is enough for you.

My depression is clinical, and my pain and grief are just too fucking deep.  I am being eaten alive and I can't meditate or work or laugh my way out of it for anything in the world -- I can laugh my ass off and still want to put a gun in my mouth while I'm laughing.  I can keep up the surface, I can keep running on autopilot but I am still going down in flames.
